interface.shortDescription: Search FAA airmen certificates, ratings, and informational medical records via MCP. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.
interface.longDescription: Search a local FAA releasable snapshot for airmen certificates, complete ratings, instructor records, remote pilot records, and informational medical fields. Six read-only tools preserve source provenance and distinguish identity candidates without asserting current privileges or fitness. Initialize and refresh the mirror separately with the operator CLI; no API key is required. Street addresses are discarded, and city and ZIP access requires explicit operator opt-in.
